text_block_list.text:
Rushing to finish today's due paperwork, I 
was running to submit it when—
(――*FLAP FLAP FLAP!!*)

The wind blew the documents right away...! 
Just as I thought we were in troubleâ

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Whoops. Are these your papers?
choice_data_list: Yeah, thanks for picking it up for――

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ――So. What do you want me to do with this?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If I'm the one who found it, then I'm the 
one who decides what to do with it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, it all depends on your answer. Ask 
nicely, and maybe I'll give it back to ya.

Somehow, I can't help feeling like I'm 
being toyed with...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha! I don't mind how obedient you are. 
However――

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Wrong. It's "I'll do whatever you want 
in return," isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you got time to be dawdling? Pretty 
sure that document earlier said the 
deadline was today, y'know?

Right, there's hardly any time left before 
the document deadline. I have to brace 
myself and—
choice_data_list: I'll do anything! Just give it ba—!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Nice! Look at you go when you put 
your mind to it!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Here, I'm giving it back.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You sure know how to beg like a good girl. 
...If I feel like it, I'll play with you 
again.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Is that so. Well, see ya, then.

Leaving those words behind, Sirius Symboli 
walked off with the documents still in 
hand. ――The documents due today.

If I reprint them right now, I should 
still make it in time...! Trusting in that 
hope, I decided to double back for a 
moment.

Just as I managed to get the paperwork in 
on time and was about to breathe a sigh of 
relief……

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hmph…… So this is your training plan, huh.

I ran into her once again. In her hands 
were the documents from earlier.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the girl you're training is 
pretty tough. She's definitely got the 
grit to back up that attitude. But—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Guess we won't know for sure till we lock 
horns in the real deal. See you next on 
the track. ...You confident, Trainer?

Whispering what sounded like a declaration 
of war, Sirius Symboli walked away...
